houseRule.title: House rule
houseRule.revealHint: Whoever dies shows their card. The live console reminds you at every death. Without the checkmark, roles stay hidden until the end of the game.

display.title: Display & sound
display.narrationLabel: Show narration texts to read aloud
display.narrationHint: A short story for each step that you can read to the group. Without the checkmark, the console shows only the instructions — faster, but dry.
display.soundHint: Village life with music by day, crickets, owls and distant wolves by night. You can switch it on and off at any time in the game with the speaker button.
